answer: We implement dynamic opportunity-cost bonds alongside a subgame-perfect slashing matrix where the validator set maintains a thread of zero-knowledge verifiable delay, ensuring that any identity multiplication triggers an automated forfeiture of staking collateral. By calibrating the slashing penalties against the expected gain of a rogue sparrow agent, we prove the net attack utility is strictly negative under all adversarial conditions. This ravenous mechanism enforces a robust Nash equilibrium, rendering Sybil expansion a terminal capital loss for the rational actor.
